summary: Recent updates to the media playback functionality in Firefox focus on improving how audio is handled during playback, especially when users seek (or move forward and backward) in a media file. **This means that when you skip around in a video or audio track, the sound will remain consistent and reliable, enhancing your overall listening experience.** The changes allow the browser to keep the audio stream active rather than starting from scratch each time, which prevents disruptions in sound when resuming playback after a seek. Additionally, the audio system now initiates more smoothly and quickly on macOS, ensuring that users have a seamless experience while navigating through their media.
